hover_tips.title: Hit Points (HP)
hover_tips.description: If you run out of HP, you die.

hover_tips.title: Gold
hover_tips.description: How much Gold you have. Gold is the currency within the Spire.

hover_tips.title: Floor
hover_tips.description: How far up you have climbed.

hover_tips.title: Vantom
hover_tips.description: At the end of the act, you will fight Vantom.

hover_tips.title: Deck (D)
hover_tips.description: View all of the cards in your deck.

hover_tips.title: Settings (ESC)
hover_tips.description:
Opens the game menu.

Change or update your graphics, audio, and gameplay preferences here.

hover_tips.title: Energy
hover_tips.description: Your current Energy ( <Energy>) count. Cards require <Energy> to play, indicated in the top left corner.

hover_tips.title: Orb Slot
hover_tips.description: Orbs can be channeled into these slots.

hover_tips.title: Draw Pile (A)
hover_tips.description:
At the start of each turn,
5 cards are drawn from here.

Click to view the cards in your draw pile (shuffled).

hover_tips.title: Discard Pile (S)
hover_tips.description:
If your draw pile is empty, the discard pile is shuffled into the draw pile.

Click to view the cards in your discard pile.

hover_tips.title: End Turn (E)
hover_tips.description:
Pressing this button will end your turn.

You will discard your hand, enemies will take their turn, you will draw 5 cards, then it will be your turn again.
